title: Burnside Partition Moments: First, Second and Third Moments for k = 1 through 10
subject: Fixed set partitions under permutations

definitions.E_k: The set of set partitions of a labeled k-element set
definitions.C_sigma: The number of elements of E_k fixed by the permutation sigma
definitions.M_j_k: (1/k!) times the sum of C_sigma^j over sigma in S_k
definitions.p_k: The number of integer partitions of k
definitions.orbit_interpretation: M_j(k) counts diagonal S_k orbits of ordered j-tuples of set partitions

reported_method.cycle_type_formula: C(lambda) = sum over partitions pi of the cycle index set of the product over blocks B of sum over positive d dividing gcd(lambda_i : i in B) of d^(|B|-1)
reported_method.cycle_type_weight: z_lambda = product over j of j^(m_j) times m_j!
reported_method.moment_aggregation: M_j(k) = sum over integer partitions lambda of k of C(lambda)^j / z_lambda
reported_method.subset_recurrence: F(empty) = 1; F(S) = sum over B contained in S and containing a fixed chosen i in S of w(B) F(S minus B)

reported_validation.check: First moment equals the integer partition count
Cycle-type formula agrees with direct fixed-partition counting
Direct enumeration of permutations and set partitions for all three moments
